body:
<!-- plain-summary -->
Wyrd's server program is started with a switch that says which bookkeeping database to use. This issue adds "fdb" as a third choice next to the existing two, so an operator can run the same Wyrd binary against FoundationDB just by changing configuration — no code changes, no separate build beyond enabling the feature.

## What

Extend backend selection in `crates/server/src/cli.rs` (the `MetadataBackend` enum at `cli.rs:76`, built by #255's pattern on `feat/m4-production-metadata-backend`) with an `Fdb` variant:

- `--metadata-backend fdb` (and the config-file equivalent), compiled only under `--features fdb`, with the same friendly build-error message shape as TiKV's ("requires building `wyrd` with `--features fdb`").
- Startup hint line: `fdb backend: set WYRD_FDB_CLUSTER_FILE to the cluster file path` (parallel to the `WYRD_TIKV_PD_ENDPOINTS` hint).
- Usage strings updated: `[--metadata-backend redb|tikv|fdb]`.
- Unknown-value error text lists all three.

## What must keep working unchanged

- `alloc_inode`'s time-budgeted retry loop (`ALLOC_INODE_BUDGET` + capped exponential backoff) operates purely on `CommitOutcome::Conflict` — it must work against the FDB driver with no changes. Add the FDB case to the backend-selection integration tests (`crates/server/tests/backend_selection.rs`), including the paused-clock exhaustion test parameterized over the backend where feasible.
- `redb` remains the zero-dependency default; TiKV selection is untouched until the decommission issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- `wyrd … --metadata-backend fdb` runs the demo flow against the compose cluster from the harness issue.
- Backend-selection tests cover: fdb selected, fdb requested without the feature (clean error), unknown value lists `fdb`.
- No behavior change for `redb`/`tikv` paths.

## Sequencing

Depends on #438 (driver) and pairs with #439 (harness provides the cluster the integration test needs). Targets `main` after `feat/m4-production-metadata-backend` merges.

milestone.title: Metadata Store FoundationDB
milestone.description: Production distributed MetadataStore backend on FoundationDB — the chosen production backend per ADR-0042. metadata-fdb behind the fdb feature (implementation-first per ADR-0002; contract docs consolidated afterwards in #437), libfdb_c packaging + wyrd:fdb image, dev/CI harness, deploy profiles, go/no-go fault+contention battery, and the TiKV development stand-down once FDB is the default. (Renamed from metadata-client.)

title: Server backend selection: add fdb as a third --metadata-backend choice
